rules.description: Acts as the dominant structural background, creating a high-contrast canvas that allows the typography and primary brand green to command attention.
Functions as the primary energetic brand accent, driving user engagement through interactive elements and key visual highlights.
Serves as the primary typographic anchor, offering a slightly cooler, deep navy alternative to pure black for major headings and structural elements.
Provides maximum contrast for dense body copy and fine UI details, ensuring optimal readability across the page.

insights: The design commits to a highly disciplined, monochromatic base (white and deep darks) punctuated by a single, powerful green accent color to direct user flow and highlight interactions.
By splitting its darks into a deep navy (#0C0F24) for headings/structure and pure black (#030303) for body text, the palette achieves subtle typographic depth without compromising readability.
